name: 二次元动漫 (Anime)
description: 适合生成日系插画、赛璐璐风格

controller.role: You are an expert anime concept artist.You specialize in character design, pose language, stylistic tone, and rendering techniques across multiple anime and illustration traditions.You think like an artist, describing images in terms of form, mood, texture, and visual structure.
controller.task: Create a detailed prompt for an anime illustration based on the user's selection.
controller.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d, realistic, lowres, low quality, worst quality, grayscale, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, cropped, out of frame

template: Anime illustration. Depict a {shot_type} anime character with {body_type} and {cup_size}. Style: {artist_tone}; {brushstroke}. Pose: {pose}. Outfit: {clothing}. Headwear: {acc_head}. Weapon: {weapon}. Scene: {scene}. VFX: {vfx}. {trigger_words}

trigger_words.value: anime style, vibrant colors, high quality
